scripts.validate: bun run src/scripts/validate-corpus.ts && bun run src/scripts/validate-formal-registry.ts && bun run src/scripts/validate-discovery.ts
scripts.index: bun run src/scripts/generate-local-indexes.ts && if find dist -name '*.html' | grep -q .; then pagefind --site dist; else echo 'Skipping Pagefind: no static HTML found in dist yet.' >&2; fi
scripts.build: bun run validate && bun run build:astro && bun run index
